assessment: In this study, Krasniewski and colleagues describe important findings leveraging single-cell transcriptomics to identify subpopulations of macrophages in the skeletal muscle of aging mice. They present solid evidence for the existence of several new resident subpopulations of skeletal muscle macrophages, spanning a range of polarization states using novel markers. Additionally, they identify a shift in relative abundances of these subpopulations with age, leading to a functional shift in inflammatory marker expression and phagocytic capacity. This work will be useful to researchers in the field of immune aging as a resource.
